title: Angular Developer
tagline: Master the full Angular stack: signals, RxJS, NgRx and testing
description: A focused track for developers who want to specialise in Angular. After the web fundamentals and TypeScript you go deep into Angular 22, reactive programming with RxJS, state management with NgRx and a solid testing practice.
audience: Developers targeting Angular roles or enterprise frontend teams

stages.title: HTML foundations
stages.description: Semantic markup, forms and accessibility basics that Angular templates build on.

stages.title: CSS and layout
stages.description: Flexbox, grid, responsive design and component-scoped styling.

stages.title: JavaScript essentials
stages.description: Functions, closures, classes, modules, promises and async/await.

stages.title: TypeScript in depth
stages.description: Types, generics, decorators and strict mode, the language Angular is written in.

stages.title: Angular
stages.description: Components, signals, control flow, routing, forms, HTTP, dependency injection and SSR.

stages.title: RxJS
stages.description: Observables and operators for HTTP, events and complex asynchronous flows.

stages.title: NgRx state management
stages.description: Store, effects, selectors, entities and the SignalStore for large applications.

stages.title: Angular testing
stages.description: Unit and component tests with Vitest and TestBed, plus end-to-end tests with Playwright.
stages.topicNote: Angular testing is taught inside the Angular tutorial's testing lessons together with the Vitest and Playwright tutorials; there is no separate Angular Testing tutorial.

seo.title: Angular Developer Learning Path
seo.description: Roadmap from HTML, CSS and TypeScript into Angular 22, RxJS, NgRx state management and Angular testing with Vitest and Playwright.
